title: Harvest Readiness, Sanitary Handling & Lot Integrity
level: Postharvest Quality Specialist / advanced specialization development
intendedAudience: Learners entering the Postharvest Quality Specialist pathway
Cultivation and postharvest personnel responsible for harvest readiness, sanitary handling, lot identity, transfers and initial postharvest quality records
prerequisites: Cultivation Technician II harvest/postharvest foundation or equivalent
evidencePolicy: Course uses cannabis-specific peer-reviewed postharvest and maturity evidence plus controlled data-integrity/traceability sources. Maturity indicators are interpreted through representative sampling and product objectives; no universal trichome-color percentage or calendar date is presented as a harvest rule.
assessmentPolicy: Development-only until technical/assessment review, accessibility review and pilot evidence are complete. Course completion does not authorize final product release, destruction, laboratory disposition or jurisdiction-specific compliance decisions outside assigned authority.
description: Develops specialist harvest-readiness evaluation, sanitary harvest handling, lot creation/split/merge controls, contamination prevention and reconstructable transfer into drying.
learningOutcomes: Evaluate harvest readiness using representative maturity observations, crop objectives, developmental context and sampling limits rather than a single flower, calendar date or universal visual threshold.
Design a sanitary harvest-handling workflow that protects material identity, minimizes contamination and preserves worker/process safety through cutting, transport and staging.
Create and maintain lot identity across harvest, splits, transfers, drying-room/rack assignment and later sample relationships without undocumented mixing or relabeling.
Detect and contain harvest-stage deviations such as sanitation failure, identity uncertainty, damaged material or environmental delay while preserving affected scope and evidence.
Produce a reconstructable harvest-to-dry handoff record with source identity, time, location, condition, sanitation status, lot genealogy, deviations and next responsible role.
